address: San Agustin del Guadalix, 28750 Madrid, Spain
profile.reading: This Data4 facility, coded MAD02, is located in San Agustin del Guadalix, 28750 Madrid, Spain, part of the operator own 2 building Madrid campus. The operator own page gives this building a capacity of 50 MW across approximately 6.7 hectares. The full Madrid campus totals 10.7 hectares and 100 MW combined across both buildings, MAD01 and MAD02. Data4 is a data center operator founded in 2006 and headquartered in Paris, France, operating campuses in France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Germany, and Greece.
